appearance.introText: Light or dark, background tone and accent colour. Changes apply at once in every window; the video picture always stays dark.
appearance.modeNote: “Like the system” follows light and dark from your system's settings.
appearance.accentNote: For selection, main buttons, progress and icons. On light surfaces Lurk takes a stronger version automatically; very light custom colours are darkened so the text on buttons stays readable.

playback.hoverPreview: Live preview when hovering over a tile
playback.hoverPreviewNote: When the pointer rests on a live stream for a moment, the tile plays it muted in low quality. This uses some data. With “Reduce motion” turned on in the system, the still image stays.
playback.followRaidsNote: When the Twitch channel you are watching starts a raid, Lurk shows the target and goes along as soon as the raid starts. Applies at once, also to the stream that is playing.
playback.showChat: Show the chat beside live streams
playback.thirdPartyEmotes: Show emotes of BTTV, 7TV and FFZ (Twitch)
playback.thirdPartyEmotesNote: For this, Lurk asks BetterTTV, 7TV and FrankerFaceZ for the global emotes and those of the channel – without an account, without cookies.
playback.animatedEmotesNote: With “reduce motion” on in your system, emotes always stay still.
playback.liveNotifications: Notify when subscribed channels go live
playback.liveNotificationsNote: Lurk checks every two minutes while the app is open.

privacy.introText: Lurk does not sign in to Twitch. History, remembered positions and settings stay on this computer. Requests go out without credentials and without cookies.

blocker.introTitle: An ad blocker modelled on uBlock Origin
blocker.introText: Lurk removes ads from Twitch's playlists and skips ad breaks before you see them. It blocks tracker and ad servers before a request reaches the network. Everything runs on this computer – filter lists are not downloaded.
blocker.enabledNote: New requests follow the setting at once, a running stream from its next start. In the player, the shield switches it directly.
blocker.adFillClips: Show the channel's clips during ads
blocker.adFillClipsNote: While Lurk skips ads on Twitch, a random popular clip of the channel plays instead of a waiting picture. The note with the time left stays at the edge, not in the middle of the picture.
blocker.listsNote: Built in and made for Twitch: ad segments and their markers in the playlists (m3u-prune) and known tracker and ad servers.
blocker.ownNote: uBlock syntax: ||server^ blocks a server, @@||server^ allows it again, $important wins over exceptions, twitch.tv##+js(m3u-prune, pattern, .m3u8) removes lines from playlists, ! starts a comment. Lurk skips cosmetic filters, since it shows no web pages.
blocker.saveFailed: Not saved – the file could not be written.
blocker.skipped_one: 1 line skipped – cosmetic filters or rules for other sites.
blocker.skipped_other: {{number}} lines skipped – cosmetic filters or rules for other sites.

issue.scriptlet: The scriptlet “{{name}}” is not supported in Lurk
issue.type: The request type “{{name}}” does not occur in Lurk

blocker.logEmpty: Nothing blocked in this session yet – entries appear as soon as Lurk removes ads or blocks a request.

log.prune_one: {{channel}}: 1 ad segment ({{seconds}} s) removed from the playlist
log.prune_other: {{channel}}: {{number}} ad segments ({{seconds}} s) removed from the playlist
log.switch: {{channel}}: ad break avoided – same stream from a second source

replay.adSwitch: Switch to another subscribed channel during ad breaks
replay.adSwitchNote: Lurk detects ad breaks in the stream and meanwhile shows the subscribed channel you have watched longest that is live without ads right now. Afterwards it switches back by itself. Without such a channel the ad plays as usual – with the ad blocker, Lurk hides it.
replay.rankingEmpty: No watch time yet – it counts as soon as you watch streams.
